### Do Your Emotions Lie to You?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-november-14-2023.html
Passage: Genesis 50:24-26
Points:
- Joseph looked beyond Egypt's security and comfort because true faith relies on God's promises over outward appearances.
- Emotions and feelings are deceptive and changeable, whereas God's Word remains entirely dependable.
- Genuine faith rests upon the unshakeable power of God rather than human feelings or reasoning.
- Christians should identify where emotions override Scripture and bring those struggles to the Lord in prayer.

### Take Me Back to Canaan
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/take-me-back-canaan
Passage: Genesis 50:25
Points:
- Despite his elevated position and comforts in Egypt, Joseph knew a better inheritance lay ahead in Canaan.
- Requesting the relocation of his bones demonstrated unwavering trust in God's covenant promises and resurrection hope.
- Joseph's life proved that God is completely faithful to His promises, even when the journey is long.
- Believers today can trust that God is steadily moving His people toward the final fulfillment of His kingdom.
